newsitem.title: USA: Urologix seen profitable in Q1 FY99.
newsitem.headline: Urologix seen profitable in Q1 FY99.

text.p: PaineWebber analyst Charles Olsziewski on Monday predicted that Urologix Inc would become profitable in the first quarter of fiscal 1999.
Olsziewski started coverage of Urologix with a rating of attractive. He estimated the company's fiscal 1997 loss per share at $0.80 and at $0.55 in fiscal 1998.

The company produces a catheter-based therapy that uses microwave technology to treat enlarged prostate glands. It has sought approval to market the so-called T3 System with the U.S. Food and Drug Administration.
"The T3 System is already available for sale in Europe, Canada and Japan," Olsziewski wrote in an analysis.
"It has signed marketing agreements with Boston Scientific Corp and Nihon Khoden, a $600 million Japanese medical device manufacturer."
He added, "We look for the company to receive final (marketing) clearance for the T3 System by the end of calendar 1997 and to achieve profitability in the first quarter of fiscal 1999."
The company's fiscal year ends in June.
